audit.framing_9x16: Dynamic vertical split screen with top facecam and bottom gameplay or live camera feed, scaling dynamically based on active speakers and action context.
audit.subtitle_craft: High-contrast centered captions with vibrant green/red coloring per word chunk, popping dynamically in size during high-energy moments like screams or disbelief.
audit.zoom_and_camera_work: Subtle 1.1x-1.3x punch-ins on facial expressions and reaction moments, synchronized with comedic pauses to heighten dramatic effect.
audit.sfx_and_music_craft: Energetic background track paired with sharp, percussive impact SFX underlining sudden streamer outbursts and unexpected comedic turns.
audit.comedic_timing_and_cuts: Tight rhythm building from setup to escalation, holding on reactions just long enough for the punchline to land naturally before immediately cutting to the next segment.
standout_techniques: Dynamic word-by-word color-coded captioning with scale-pop animation on emphasis words
Split-screen 9:16 framing keeping both reaction cam and corresponding gameplay/footage perfectly readable
Precise punch-in zoom timing synchronized with audio peaks for maximum comedic impact
Clean out-point selection holding just past the punchline before hard cutting to the next clip
anti_patterns_to_avoid: Over-cluttering the vertical screen with too many overlapping chat widgets and UI elements
Extraneous lingering on dead air before the comedic payoff
